models_evaluated: Basic dementia risk prediction model (age, history of stroke, subjective memory complaints, need for assistance with a complex task)

links.outcome: Discrimination (c-statistic) and calibration of dementia risk model in external population cohort
links.effect: Overall c-statistic 0.62 (95% CI 0.48-0.70); 0.67 (0.57-0.78) at follow-up 2a; poor calibration with systematic overestimation of predicted risk; only 36 self-reported dementia cases.
links.quote: However, calibration of the model in this external validation cohort was poor, with systematic overestimation of the predicted risk.

screen.reason: The study conducts an external validation (discrimination and calibration) of a previously developed dementia risk prediction model in a population cohort, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
